note: Commerce Authorize.net provides Commerce payment gateway plugins: authorizenet_acceptjs (on-site cards, primary), authorizenet_accept_hosted (off-site iframe), authorizenet_echeck (ACH), authorizenet_visa_checkout (legacy/deprecated). Each is a commerce_payment_gateway config entity whose configuration carries api_login, transaction_key, client_key and a Commerce mode of 'test' or 'live' (schema in config/schema/commerce_authnet.schema.yml; acceptjs adds enable_credit_card_icons, accept_hosted adds captcha_security + card_code_required, visa_checkout adds visa_checkout_api_key). Accept.js defines workflow payment_acceptjs. IMPORTANT: live charges need a real Authorize.Net account and API creds we do NOT have, so every medium/hard case is grounded in the commerce_payment_gateway CONFIG ENTITY (which saves/loads without contacting Authorize.Net) and NEVER in live transactions. All fixtures use ca_-prefixed gateway ids.

evals.prompt: Which Commerce payment gateway plugins does the commerce_authnet module provide for Authorize.Net, and which one is the primary on-site credit card integration?
evals.expected_output: authorizenet_acceptjs (on-site credit cards via Accept.js — the primary/recommended), authorizenet_accept_hosted (off-site hosted iframe form), authorizenet_echeck (ACH/eCheck), and the legacy/deprecated authorizenet_visa_checkout.

evals.prompt: To configure a commerce_authnet payment gateway, which Authorize.Net credential settings must be provided, and how do you make the gateway run against a sandbox instead of taking real payments?
evals.expected_output: Provide api_login (API Login ID), transaction_key (Transaction Key) and client_key (public Client Key) on the gateway's configuration, and set the Commerce gateway mode to 'test' (sandbox) instead of 'live'.

evals.prompt: In commerce_authnet, which gateway plugin renders an off-site hosted card form in an iframe, and which one takes bank-account (ACH/eCheck) payments?
evals.expected_output: authorizenet_accept_hosted renders the off-site Accept Hosted iframe form; authorizenet_echeck handles ACH/eCheck payments (payment method type authnet_echeck).

evals.prompt: This Drupal Commerce site has an Authorize.net payment gateway with machine name ca_known. Inspect the live payment gateway configuration and report which commerce_authnet gateway plugin it uses and whether it is in test or live mode.
evals.expected_output: ca_known uses the authorizenet_acceptjs plugin and is in test mode (commerce_payment_gateway.ca_known, configuration.mode = test).

evals.prompt: On this site there is an Authorize.net eCheck payment gateway with machine name ca_known2. Inspect the live configuration and report its Authorize.Net API Login ID and which gateway plugin it uses.
evals.expected_output: ca_known2 uses the authorizenet_echeck plugin with api_login 'echeck_login_xyz' (commerce_payment_gateway.ca_known2 configuration.api_login).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal Commerce site, create an Authorize.net payment gateway using commerce_authnet. Make it a commerce_payment_gateway config entity with machine name ca_task using the Accept.js gateway plugin (authorizenet_acceptjs) in TEST mode, with the API Login ID, Transaction Key, and Client Key all set to placeholder values. Save it to the live site. (Do not attempt any live transaction.)
evals.expected_output: A commerce_payment_gateway config entity ca_task exists with plugin authorizenet_acceptjs, mode test, and non-empty api_login, transaction_key and client_key in its configuration.

evals.prompt: Using commerce_authnet, add an Authorize.net Accept Hosted payment gateway (plugin authorizenet_accept_hosted) to this Commerce site as a payment gateway config entity with machine name ca_hosted_task, configured in LIVE mode. Save it to the live site (no real payment should be attempted).
evals.expected_output: A commerce_payment_gateway config entity ca_hosted_task exists with plugin authorizenet_accept_hosted and mode live.
